Description.SourceString:
Sadly, this is not a new hairstyle unlock, rather it’s a special cloth created by the Moon Garou. They say it’s woven from moon sprite silk, which can only be obtained in the light of a full moon and, even then, only by shamans. 

The truth is that it’s less complicated than that. It’s crafted by a gaggle of garou grannies, each of them weaving together special fibres that have been passed down their family line for generations. Each bolt of cloth may seem the same, but they are each a unique blending of garou family craftwork.
